summary.text: The landlord did not give approval by 13 December as expected. They now say 20 December, which is a week late.

quotes.text: The landlord didn't approve by the thirteenth, they now say the twentieth of December, a week late.

summary.text: Kemlite's start on site depends on the approval, so it moves from 28 December to 4 January.

quotes.text: That pushes Kemlite's start on site to the fourth of January instead of the twenty eighth of December.
the approval is what the start hangs off

summary.text: The delay is within the two-week stage time tolerance, so no exception report is needed yet. Jonas pointed out that it already uses half of the tolerance.

quotes.text: It's within the stage time tolerance of two weeks, so no exception report yet.
It's inside the tolerance, but basically it's already using up half of it.

summary.text: The IT director gave the project the third and fourth weeks of January, not the second and third, because the portal team has the second week.

quotes.text: The IT director gave us the third and fourth week of January, not the second and third, because the portal team has the second week.

summary.text: The new weeks still work with Kemlite starting on 4 January, because cabling can go in after Kemlite's first fix.

quotes.text: cabling can um go in after the first fix, so third and fourth week is fine.
the first fix is theirs. After that, the cabling can go in.

summary.text: The standard desks were ordered on the third. They arrive in the second week of February, before the move-in.

quotes.text: The standard desks were ordered on the third, so they arrive in basically the second week of February, before the move-in.

summary.text: The risk on the desks is much lower now. Only the meeting room tables are still open, and Grace asked for them to stay on watch.

quotes.text: So the desk risk is much lower now. Only the meeting room tables are still open.
Keep the tables kind of on watch.

actions.text: Keep the meeting room tables on watch.

quotes.text: Keep the tables kind of on watch.

summary.text: Kemlite signed the contract on the fifth. Their site manager, Halim, will attend the next board.

quotes.text: Kemlite signed the contract on the fifth. Their site manager is Halim, he'll be at the next board.

summary.text: Grace asked for Halim to bring a three-week look-ahead to that board. The request is to be made in a friendly way.

quotes.text: Please ask kind of Halim to bring the three-week look-ahead to that meeting.
Yes, of course. I'll keep it friendly.

actions.text: Ask Halim to bring the three-week look-ahead to the next board.

quotes.text: Will do.
I'll make sure Halim knows that's what you're asking for. I'll say bring the look-ahead, and that it's three weeks.

summary.text: This is a new item. The SCDF fire safety certificate is needed before anyone can occupy the floor, and inspections are booking six weeks out.

quotes.text: We need the SCDF fire safety certificate before anyone can occupy the floor, and inspections are booking six weeks out.

summary.text: If the inspection is not booked by early January, the move-in might not happen on time. Wei Ling called this a risk, not a certainty.

quotes.text: If we don't book the inspection by early January, we might not be allowed to move in on time.
It's a risk, not a certainty.

summary.text: Ravi will ask Kemlite to submit the application as soon as they mobilise. They have not agreed to this yet. This request is separate from the look-ahead request.

quotes.text: I'll ask Kemlite to submit the application as soon as they mobilise.
I'll ask. I'm not telling you they've said yes, because I haven't asked yet.
The look-ahead I mean is one thing. The application is the other.

actions.text: Ask Kemlite to submit the fire safety certificate application as soon as they mobilise.

quotes.text: I'll ask Kemlite to submit the application as soon as they mobilise.
